content.rationale: The child is source and the runner it stands on (zruxtxrv) is source, while the read (kywmkqlm) and the flat-layout rule (szmuyqrq) are prose about that source, so the sharpest cell here is code-to-code and the check runs rather than reviews; because the prose's dashes are observable, the two natural-to-code edges are enforced by the same runnable check, neither stricter nor looser than the prose. The check observes the crossing rather than the module's wording: a recording stand-in in front of a real jj counts the crossings the read makes (one for the whole set, so neither a read per change nor a second crossing for the paths), inspects the one crossing it makes (a listing whose template carries the diff summary, so the paths ride that crossing rather than a read of their own), and compares the returned pairs against a scratch repo's changes read independently of the module (every change, each carrying its own paths, a rename's two sides, and no filter — the scratch repo carries no ownership documents at all, so a read narrowed to what a node claims would return nothing); it also pins that a failed crossing and a binary that cannot spawn come back as carried values rather than panics, which is the runner's own rule. The shim's include path fixes the layout: the module is one file directly under src/, since a directory module cannot be reached at src/jj_custody.rs. The id's spelling is not pinned — the check accepts the full change id, its short form, or a longer unique prefix — because naming a change is the read's business and only the pairing is the addition.
